strings.name: The Weeknd
strings.summary: Born Abel Tesfaye, the Weeknd emerged through Toronto mixtapes, combining alternative R&B, synth-pop and cinematic visuals. Beauty Behind the Madness and After Hours brought him to global mainstream stages. His albums build connected narratives: the trilogy ended in 2025, but he continued creating and performing in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through works including After Hours, he blends R&B, electronic pop and cinematic visuals, influencing contemporary pop aesthetics.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Toronto, Ontario, Canada; raised in Scarborough
strings.facts.f2.label: Education

strings.highlights.h1.title: Sound and visual storytelling
strings.highlights.h1.text: After Hours and other work connect alternative R&B with retro electronic pop.
strings.highlights.h2.title: From online releases to major stages
strings.highlights.h2.text: Progressed from 2011 mixtapes to the 2021 Super Bowl halftime show.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Hong Kong video
strings.timeline.t1.text: Shared the video for his duet with Faye Wong after its live premiere in Hong Kong.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Hurry Up Tomorrow
strings.timeline.t2.text: Released the concluding album of the After Hours trilogy; this was not retirement.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Dawn FM
strings.timeline.t3.text: Organized the album around a radio-station concept.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Super Bowl halftime show
strings.timeline.t4.text: Headlined the Super Bowl LV halftime performance.
strings.timeline.t5.title: After Hours
strings.timeline.t5.text: Released the album featuring Blinding Lights; the single preceded it.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Beauty Behind the Madness
strings.timeline.t6.text: Expanded his mainstream audience with Can’t Feel My Face and The Hills.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Trilogy
strings.timeline.t7.text: Released remastered versions of the three 2011 mixtapes together.
strings.timeline.t8.title: House of Balloons
strings.timeline.t8.text: Released his first mixtape online, followed by two more.
